pressure_interpretation: Assume published oceanographic vertical pressure coordinate is sea pressure; do not subtract atmospheric pressure again. The paper does not independently supply a pressure-datum calibration for each reported reversal.
latitude_interpretation: A nominal latitude approximation for the pair-averaged descriptor, not the location of a measured current axis or proof of uniform pressure-to-depth relation throughout the section.
uncertainty_policy: Physical boundary uncertainty is unknown. Native pressures are approximate. Endpoint-latitude sensitivity is only the sensitivity to that latitude choice; it omits source/profile errors, ocean-state and geopotential corrections, and is not an error bound or confidence interval.
